title: copperbench fixture manifest
description: Provenance, scale, and baseline verification state for one frozen fixture. Metadata about the fixture; never copied into a sandbox. See fixtures/FIXTURES.md.

id.description: Matches the fixture directory name. Prefix with the upstream origin where the board is third-party.

sha256.description: Canonical hash of tree/ only, per STANDARD.md section 3.2. Metadata files are excluded so provenance edits do not invalidate results.

complexity.description: Scale of the fixture. Independent of a task's tier: a simple task may target a subsystem of a hard fixture.

commit.description: Full SHA. A tag or branch is not sufficient: both move.

license.description: Permitted licenses only (FIXTURES.md section 3). Reciprocal and non-commercial licenses are not vendored.

licenseFile.description: Path to the verbatim upstream license within the fixture directory.

modifications.description: What was and was not copied, and any change to a design file. The strongly preferred value states that no design file was altered.

authoredVersion.description: KiCad version the upstream project states it was designed in.

fileFormatVersion.description: The (version ...) token from the .kicad_sch. Legacy .sch fixtures are rejected.

verifiedWithKicadCli.description: Reference kicad-cli version that produced the baseline reports.

schematic.description: Path within tree/ to the root schematic.

scale.description: Recorded so a task author calibrates a diff bound against a known denominator rather than inheriting a constant.

baseline.description: Baseline verification state. Errors must be zero; warnings are expected and recorded so tasks can assert no NEW violations.

errors.description: A fixture with baseline errors is rejected: a pre-existing error is indistinguishable from an agent-introduced one.

unconnectedItems.description: Must be zero: this is what a bad edit breaks, so it cannot be dirty at baseline.
